description: This file defines the ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException class, a custom exception indicating invalid connection configuration in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested builder classes and static factory methods for creating instances based on message or JSON input.

classes.name: ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating invalid connection configuration, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing ConnectivityException. It is annotated for immutability and JSON parsing, with static factory methods for construction.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A nested mutable builder class for ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException, providing a fluent API for constructing exception instances with optional custom message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with a specified error message.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a new ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException object with a specified message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a new exception object from a JSON representation and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides superclass method to set new headers and return a copy of the exception.
